people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.
translations.bsb: “Swear to me first,” Jacob said. So Esau swore to Jacob and sold him the birthright.
translations.kjv: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
translations.asv: And Jacob said, Swear to me first. And he sware unto him. And he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
